llm.summary: This is a coherent wardrobe assistant skill that stores closet and preference data locally and may use weather lookups, with no evidence of hidden exfiltration or unsafe automation.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads and may mutate local wardrobe, preference, and config files, and can use external weather retrieval when needed; this is proportionate to the purpose, though weather lookup transparency should be considered.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown specifications plus JSON seed/config files; I found no executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, services, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly require fact grounding, separation of state layers, confirmation for deletion or ambiguous writes, and no bypass of confirmation or authorization boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent wardrobe and preference storage is disclosed and purpose-aligned, with safeguards against broad or low-confidence writes, but the spec allows some clear long-term preference writes without separate confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated closet-stylist purpose: wardrobe CRUD, wardrobe queries, outfit recommendations, item notes, durable style preferences, image-assisted intake, and weather-aware advice.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you are comfortable with the skill maintaining a local wardrobe and long-term style preference profile. Review or clear the local user data files when needed, confirm destructive wardrobe changes, and be mindful that weather-aware requests may involve sending a city or location context to an external weather source.
llm.findings:
[P3] unexpected: The cited text says not to quietly record deletion-like statements as notes; it is a protective confirmation-boundary rule, not an exfiltration command.
[MP3] unexpected: The cited 'non-overwrite rules' section limits wardrobe fact handling and does not write attacker-controlled instructions into agent memory.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited passages prohibit bypassing confirmation and unauthorized state mutation; they do not enable autonomous high-impact action.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent user preferences are expected for this skill and are scoped to local preference data, but users should understand that style, color, fit, and occasion preferences may be retained across sessions.
[SQP-2] expected: Weather lookups are purpose-aligned and narrow, but users should be aware that configured or web-based weather retrieval can disclose location context to a provider.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The static SARIF scan reported no results, and artifact inspection found no executable code or install persistence.
